# VEX Corpus - Ollama Model Configuration
# Hardware: RTX 4090 (24GB), Threadripper PRO 7965WX, 128GB RAM
#
# Model Benchmark Results:
#   nemotron-mini (4.2B):   1.1s avg, 119 tok/s  -> Tier 1
#   nemotron-3-nano (31.6B): 15.9s avg, 27 tok/s -> Tier 2 (OPTIMAL)
#   nemotron (70.6B):       35.8s avg, 3.4 tok/s -> Too slow, fallback only

ollama:
  base_url: "http://localhost:11434"
  keep_alive: "24h"
  max_loaded_models: 2

# Model Tier Assignments - ALL NEMOTRON FAMILY
models:
  tier1:
    # Fast classification - 4.2B runs at 119 tok/s
    primary: "nemotron-mini:latest"
    fallbacks:
      - "nemotron-3-nano:latest"  # Fallback to nano if mini fails
    config:
      temperature: 0.1
      top_p: 0.9
      num_predict: 1024
      format: "json"

  tier2:
    # Generation tasks - 31.6B is 2.2x faster than 70B with good quality
    primary: "nemotron-3-nano:latest"
    fallbacks:
      - "nemotron:latest"         # Full 70B as last resort
      - "nemotron-mini:latest"    # Fast fallback if all else fails
    config:
      temperature: 0.3
      top_p: 0.95
      num_predict: 2048
      format: "json"

  embedding:
    primary: "nomic-embed-text"
    dimensions: 768

# Task Routing
tasks:
  # Tier 1: Fast classification (nemotron-mini 4.2B)
  # Expected: ~1-2s per task, 40+ tasks/minute
  classify_wrangle:
    tier: 1
    timeout_seconds: 15
    retries: 2
    consensus: false

  extract_attributes:
    tier: 1
    timeout_seconds: 15
    retries: 2
    consensus: false

  extract_functions:
    tier: 1
    timeout_seconds: 15
    retries: 2
    consensus: false

  detect_bugs:
    tier: 1
    timeout_seconds: 20
    retries: 2
    consensus: true

  estimate_complexity:
    tier: 1
    timeout_seconds: 15
    retries: 2
    consensus: true

  classify_topic:
    tier: 1
    timeout_seconds: 15
    retries: 2
    consensus: true

  # Tier 2: Generation tasks (nemotron-3-nano 31.6B)
  # Expected: ~15-30s per task, 3-4 tasks/minute
  generate_prompt:
    tier: 2
    timeout_seconds: 60
    retries: 2
    consensus: false

  generate_explanation:
    tier: 2
    timeout_seconds: 90
    retries: 2
    consensus: false

  inject_bug:
    tier: 2
    timeout_seconds: 60
    retries: 2
    consensus: false

  paraphrase_prompt:
    tier: 2
    timeout_seconds: 45
    retries: 2
    consensus: false

  rate_difficulty:
    tier: 2
    timeout_seconds: 45
    retries: 2
    consensus: true

  infer_context:
    tier: 2
    timeout_seconds: 60
    retries: 2
    consensus: false

# Quality Control
quality:
  flag_confidence_below: 0.6
  flag_consensus_below: 0.66
  review_queue_enabled: true

# Throughput Targets (tasks/minute) - Updated for new model config
throughput:
  tier1_target: 40    # nemotron-mini: ~1s/task
  tier2_target: 4     # nemotron-3-nano: ~15s/task
  batch_sizes:
    tier1: 10
    tier2: 3
